issue_body: Under sustained load with HTTP/2 enabled the connection pool silently exhausts without returning errors to callers. issue_title: SVID rotation race condition causes brief authentication failures under high load
issue_body: The SPIRE agent SVID rotation logic has a race condition that causes a brief window where both the old and new SVIDs are invalid from the perspective of the relying party. issue_body: The CockroachDB query optimizer produces incorrect row count estimates for queries that can use multiple partial indexes with overlapping predicates.
